test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.

**Be waiting in the wings.**

options.text: To restrict one's freedom, power, or full potential
To be protected, tutored, nurtured, or cared for by one
To suffer harm, defeat, or ruin in the pursuit of something risky
To be ready and available to help or replace someone

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **To be ready and available to help or replace someone**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Be waiting in the wings"** means to be ready and available to step in or take over a role or task when required. (मौके का इंतजार करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The vice-captain was waiting in the wings to take over if the captain was unable to continue.
 
 
• It describes a situation where someone is prepared to act or replace someone else, often in a professional or competitive setting. (किसी की जगह लेने या मदद करने के लिए तैयार रहना)
 
 
• **Example: **Several young actors are waiting in the wings for their chance to shine on stage.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 1: To restrict one's freedom, power, or full potential** (किसी की स्वतंत्रता, शक्ति या पूर्ण क्षमता को सीमित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Strict rules can sometimes restrict one's freedom to explore creative ideas.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To be protected, tutored, nurtured, or cared for by one** (किसी के द्वारा सुरक्षित, सिखाया, पोषित या देखभाल करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She was nurtured under the wings of her mentor during her early career.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To suffer harm, defeat, or ruin in the pursuit of something risky** (कुछ जोखिम भरे कार्य का प्रयास करने में नुकसान, हार या विनाश का सामना करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He took a huge financial risk and suffered defeat in the wings of a failed investment.
